theriac.definition:
n. Alt. of Theriaca
a. Alt. of Theriacal
theriac.translation: n. 解毒舐剂, 百宝丹, 万灵药

theriaca.definition:
n. An ancient composition esteemed efficacious against the
   effects of poison; especially, a certain compound of sixty-four drugs,
   prepared, pulverized, and reduced by means of honey to an electuary; --
   called also theriaca Andromachi, and Venice treacle.
n. Treacle; molasses.

theriaca andromanchi.translation: [医] 安德罗马库斯氏解毒糖剂

theriacal.definition: a. Of or pertaining to theriac; medicinal.
theriacal.translation: a. 解毒糖剂的, 药用的,医治的

therian.translation:
[动] adj.(正)兽亚纲的 
n. (正)兽亚纲哺乳动物

therianthropic.translation: 半人半兽的, 半人半兽的神的

theridiid.definition: n spider having a comb-like row of bristles on each hind foot

theridiidae.definition: n. a family of comb-footed spiders

theriodontia.definition:
n. pl. An extinct order of reptiles found in the Permian
   and Triassic formations in South Africa. In some respects they
   resembled carnivorous mammals. Called also Theromorpha.

theriomimicry.translation: [医] 兽形拟态, 似动物拟态

theriomorph.translation: 兽形物, 兽形人工制品

theriot.translation: [人名] 塞里奥特; [地名] [美国] 塞里奥特

theriotomy.translation: [医] 兽体解剖; 兽体解剖学
